purpose: Triggering accuracy. drive sits among sibling skills it delegates to, so the risk is not under-triggering alone but stealing work that belongs to a sibling. Negatives are deliberately near-misses that should route elsewhere, not obvious non-matches.
how_to_run: The scripted optimizer (skill-creator scripts/run_loop.py) does NOT work for this skill.

Its detector inspects only the FIRST tool call and scores anything that is not Skill/Read as 'did not trigger'. An orchestration skill's first move is orienting (Bash), so the score is pinned to 0 regardless of the description -- five different descriptions produced byte-identical scores.
Measure manually instead: run `claude -p <query> --output-format stream-json --verbose` in a realistic fixture and check whether Skill(drive) appears ANYWHERE in the tool sequence.
Keep a positive control in the set (N1 below). It fires first-tool on multi-reviewer-loop, so if N1 stops working the environment is broken, not the description.
fixture: git repo with docs/specs/<slug>.md, a Cargo.toml, and 2 ready beads -- drive-status reports BUILD.
